$comment: Template Claude Code project settings. Copy into your project's .claude/settings.json and adjust. The SessionStart hook runs a fail-open git drift-check (and the continuity guard if enabled) so every session opens knowing whether the checkout is clean and current. The permissions allowlist below pre-approves read-only inspection so the agent isn't prompted for routine git/ls/test reads; widen or narrow it to taste. Replace the '<test runner>' entries with your stack's commands.

hooks.command: git fetch origin --quiet 2>/dev/null; st=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); behind=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ -z "$st" ] && [ "$behind" = "0" ]; then echo 'repo: clean, up to date with upstream'; else echo "repo DRIFT: behind=$behind"; [ -n "$st" ] && echo "$st"; fi; [ -f scripts/continuity_budget.py ] && python3 scripts/continuity_budget.py --check 2>/dev/null; true

SessionStart.$comment: telemetry add-on (telemetry/README.md) — initializes the token baseline and records the session-start marker. Additive: upstream's drift-check entry above is untouched. Fail-open.
